sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer;
SELECT Name, COUNT(*) AS NumAlbums FROM Artist GROUP BY Name ORDER BY NumAlbums DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS COUNT, FirstName, LastName FROM Customer, Employee WHERE Customer.SupportRepId = Employee.EmployeeId AND Customer.SupportRepId = Employee.EmployeeId;

SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT Genre.Name) AS TrackCount
FROM Artist
JOIN Genre ON Artist.ArtistId = Genre.ArtistId
GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Genre.Name) > 1;

SELECT MONTH(INVOICE_DATE) AS Month, SUM(TOTAL) AS Revenue
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY MONTH(INVOICE_DATE)
SELECT year, population + population AS combined_population FROM country_stats GROUP BY year;

SELECT gdp_usd, gdp_per_capita_usd, life_expectancy_years, fertility_rate, urban_population_pct, internet_users_pct, unemployment_pct
FROM country_stats
GROUP BY iso3
ORDER BY gdp_usd DESC;
SELECT * FROM country_stats WHERE internet_users_pct < 10 AND internet_users_pct > 50 AND year = 2010 AND year = 2023;
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS average_flipper_length FROM penguins;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE body_mass_g > (SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'male' AND flipper_length_mm > 0 AND bill_length_mm > 0 AND bill_depth_mm > 0 AND sex = 'male' AND year = 2023);
